mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT vote_user.user_name as userName, vote_group.group_name as groupName, vote_user.user_img as userImg, vote_group.id as groupId, SUM( vote_score.score ) AS sumScore FROM vote_score LEFT JOIN vote_user ON vote_user.id = vote_score.user_id LEFT JOIN vote_group ON vote_group.id = vote_user.group_id WHERE vote_score.user_id != 0 GROUP BY vote_score.user_id ) a ORDER BY a.sumScore DESC LIMIT 10
